The regression started between 4.4 stable and 4.5 dev1, bisecting.

Reverting pr #100652 fixes the issue. CC @DeeJayLSP

I also tested with other .wav files and i was unable to reproduce the bug, so seems to be something specifically with the file provided in the mrp.

----------------------------------------

@zhangjiangen11 I don't think your issue is related to this one as this issue is related to the audio import

It seems to happen because the provided `test.wav` has a baked loop end offset right at the end of the file. And it only happens with QOA-compressed streams.

For now, I submitted bruvzg's suggestion. Shouldn't have any issue outside of this specific case other than 2 or 4 more bytes per stream playback added.
